description: Bracket-escaped node names and reserved-character escaping (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §3.4) plus bracket-after-separator descent (§3.3). Reserved chars [ ] # ' @ are escaped with an inner single-quote, verbatim from Excel structured-reference rules. `decodes_to` is the literal node name the escaped segment denotes.

cases.name: a name with a space is bracket-escaped
cases.note: Space is outside the bare-identifier set, but needs no inner-quote escape.

cases.name: escaped open bracket in a name
escaped close bracket in a name
doubled apostrophe is a literal apostrophe
bracket-escaped name after a . separator
cases.note: path.[Name] descends to a child whose name needs escaping.
